system_thesis_interpretation: This is a proposal-only, exact-six-named-life interface calibration. It tests only whether trusted allocation of public evidence using a valid THINK_0-derived own coordinate changes later provisional own-target connection proposals relative to a target-blind no-feedback selector and a fixed same-life distractor selector. It is not an autonomous-learning, memory, discovery, final-behavior, population, efficiency, superiority, transport, replication, or automatic-next-experiment system.
graph_delta_interpretation: The graph is reachable and ordered: exact-four-scope gate -> static integrity -> identical transitive review -> zero-science preflight -> shared prefix/THINK_0 -> primary definition and global measured balance -> D-defined three-arm selector -> ASCII/redacted provisional branch DREAM. The repaired v2e_branch_to_defined_life_exploratory edge gives the formerly disconnected ceilings node its necessary inbound branch predecessor: for each frozen-D life all 48 branch RETURN_SLEEP calls and all 3 MEMORY_1 checkpoints must freeze without branch-integrity failure before its exactly 1 full-context plus 16 RAG calls; PRIMARY_UNDEFINED receives none. Both branch and ceilings feed phase A; only its raw seal unlocks offline controls/scoring, then phase B, then the unconditional human stop. The concrete envelope is a legitimate static resource root and, together with reviewed approval, is required by the zero-science node; it is not a science path.
loop_delta_interpretation: All six prefixes physically execute once (514 DREAM calls) and preserve sunk artifacts; six terminal-justified THINK_0 prefixes contribute 0..72 calls with no padding. Only after every MEMORY_0/THINK artifact freezes can trusted code derive q_own, fixed q_dist, complete selector ranks, measured-balance diagnostics, and D. A post-prefix integrity failure stops all remaining branch and exploratory calls; PRIMARY_UNDEFINED excludes only that life from every D-scaled class. For D defined lives the branch is 48D recurrent calls, 48D selector traces, and 3D MEMORY_1/scorer packets; the repaired per-life dependency then yields exactly 17D exploratory calls, so total recurrent calls are 514+48D. Common logical decoding seeds are independent of arm, view, physical order, sessions, receipts, and slots, while each physical call/session/receipt remains unique. Raw outputs are append-only provisional and cannot feed truth, admission, normalization, retry, scoring, schedule, or repair. Phase A seals the complete raw graph before any scorer import; phase B verifies score/control artifacts and is the sole producer of done.json, otherwise exactly one failure marker stops the run. Durable markers may resume observation only and may never regenerate or repeat science identities.
claim_delta_interpretation: The strongest permissible report is descriptive within the exact named development lives with defined branches and frozen common randomness. It must report all six lives, D, undefined reasons, sunk calls, balance state, selectors, order/alias/shared-C survivors, provisional proposals, controls, normalization contribution, exploratory ceilings, compute, nulls, and failures. No result authorizes pooling, inference, confidence intervals, thresholds, go, repair, rerun, replication, heldout access, model adaptation, publication, external action, a second GPU run, or a broader claim.
visibility_matrix_interpretation: Static preflight audits frozen schemas and hashes without provider activity. Zero-science is synthetic-only: no public life, q, target, witness, final task, or raw cognition enters it. Shared cognition sees only bounded public/provisional content and a non-answer probe; trusted prebranch code alone sees q/balance/selector metadata; phase A audits raw lineage while scorer truth/allowlist remain forbidden; only sealed offline phase B sees q_own, witnesses, allowlist, and scores. q_dist is selection metadata only.
